articles.author: Innovative Eyewear Inc
articles.headline: Innovative Eyewear, Inc. Announces Strategic Alliance with HTC Corporation
articles.summary: Innovative Eyewear announced an HTC alliance to commercialize VIVE Eagle smart eyewear in the US through Lucyd, including prescription fulfillment. The stated September launch was prospective.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original PR Newswire explicitly August 24 08:00 ET.
